articles.title_en: The Dark Side of Transparency: Mission Variety and Industry Equilibrium in Decentralised Public Good Provision
articles.title_cn: 透明的阴暗面：分散化公共物品供给中的使命多样性与行业均衡
articles.abstract_en: We study the implications of transparency policies on decentralised public good provision by the non-profit sector. We present a model where imperfect monitoring of the use of funds interacts with the competitive structure of the non-profit sector under alternative informational regimes. Increasing transparency regarding the use of funds may have ambiguous effects on total public good provision and on donors’ welfare. On the one hand, transparency encourages all non-profit firms to engage more actively in curbing fund diversion. On the other hand, it tilts the playing field against non-profits facing higher monitoring costs, pressing them to give up on their missions. This effect on the extensive margin implies that transparency policies lead to a reduction in the diversity of social missions addressed by the non-profit sector. We show that the negative impact of transparency on social mission variety and on donors’ welfare is highest for intermediate levels of asymmetry in monitoring costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了透明度政策对非营利部门分散化公共物品供给的影响。我们提出了一个模型，其中资金使用的非完美监督与不同信息制度下非营利部门的竞争结构相互作用。提高资金使用的透明度可能对公共物品总供给和捐赠者福利产生模糊的影响。一方面，透明度鼓励所有非营利企业更积极地参与遏制资金挪用。另一方面，它使面临更高监督成本的非营利组织处于不利地位，迫使它们放弃自己的使命。这种广泛边际上的影响意味着透明度政策导致非营利部门所承担的社会使命多样性减少。我们表明，透明度对社会使命多样性和捐赠者福利的负面影响在监督成本不对称程度处于中间水平时最大。

articles.abstract_en: We assess the career earnings losses that individual Swedish workers suffered when their occupations’ employment declined. High-quality data allow us to overcome sorting into declining occupations on various attributes, including cognitive and non-cognitive skills. Our estimates show that occupational decline reduced mean cumulative earnings from 1986–2013 by no more than 2%–5%. This loss reflects a combination of reduced earnings conditional on employment, reduced years of employment and increased time spent in unemployment and retraining. While on average workers successfully mitigated their losses, those initially at the bottom of their occupations’ earnings distributions lost up to 8%–11%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了当职业就业衰退时，瑞典个体工人所遭受的职业收入损失。高质量数据使我们能够克服在认知和非认知技能等各种属性上向衰退职业的自我选择问题。我们的估计显示，职业衰退使1986-2013年间的平均累积收入减少了不超过2%–5%。这一损失反映了就业条件下收入减少、就业年限减少以及失业和再培训时间增加的组合效应。虽然平均而言，工人成功减轻了损失，但那些最初处于其职业收入分配底部的工人损失高达8%–11%。

articles.title_en: The Intergenerational Transmission of World War I on Female Labour
articles.title_cn: 第一次世界大战对女性劳动力的代际传递
articles.abstract_en: Demographic shocks tied to World War I’s high death toll induced many women to enter the labour force in the immediate post-war period. I document a positive impact of these newly employed women on the labour force participation of subsequent generations of women until today. I also find that the war permanently altered attitudes toward the role of women in the labour force. I decompose this impact into three channels of intergenerational transmission: transmission from mothers to daughters, transmission from mothers-in-law to daughters-in-law via their sons and transmission through local social interactions.
articles.abstract_cn: 与第一次世界大战高死亡人数相关的人口冲击，促使许多女性在战后初期进入劳动力市场。我记录了这些新就业女性对直至今日的后代女性劳动力参与率的积极影响。我还发现，这场战争永久性地改变了人们对女性在劳动力市场中角色的态度。我将这种影响分解为三个代际传递渠道：从母亲到女儿的传递、通过儿子从婆婆到儿媳的传递，以及通过当地社会互动的传递。

articles.title_en: Culture and Gender Differences in Willingness to Compete
articles.title_cn: 文化差异与竞争意愿中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how culture affects gender differences in willingness to compete in a large pre-registered experiment using an epidemiological approach. Our sample of 1,943 Norwegians with parents born in 59 different countries shows a smaller gender gap in willingness to compete among individuals of more gender-equal ancestries. The difference is driven by women with parents from more gender-equal countries wanting to compete more and men with the same ancestry wanting to compete less. The results are robust to controlling for a large set of factors at the individual, parental and ancestral country levels, indicating that gendered culture shapes competitive preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过流行病学方法，在一项大规模预注册实验中研究了文化如何影响竞争意愿中的性别差异。我们的样本包括1,943名挪威人，其父母出生于59个不同的国家，结果显示，在性别更平等的祖先文化背景下，个体竞争意愿的性别差距较小。这一差异主要由来自更性别平等国家的女性更愿意竞争，而相同祖先背景的男性更不愿意竞争所驱动。在控制了个体、父母及祖先国家层面的大量因素后，结果依然稳健，表明性别文化塑造了竞争偏好。

articles.title_en: Formal Employment and Organised Crime: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from Colombia
articles.title_cn: 正规就业与有组织犯罪：来自哥伦比亚的断点回归证据
articles.abstract_en: Safety net programs, common in settings with high informality like Latin America, often use a means test to establish eligibility. We ask: in settings in which organised crime provides lucrative opportunities in the informal market, will discouraging formal employment via benefits eligibility criteria increase criminal enterprise activity? We link administrative socioeconomic microdata with the universe of arrests in Medellín over a decade, and exploit exogenous variation in formal-sector employment around a socioeconomic-score cutoff, below which individuals receive generous benefits if not formally employed. Regression discontinuity estimates confirm this policy reduced formal-sector employment and generated a corresponding increase in arrests associated with organised crime. We do not find increases for crimes unlikely to be associated with organised entities, such as crimes of impulse or opportunity. Effects on arrests are strongest in neighbourhoods where organised crime is most prevalent.
articles.abstract_cn: 安全网项目在非正规性高的环境中（如拉丁美洲）很常见，通常使用经济状况调查来确定资格。我们提出的问题是：在有组织犯罪为非正规市场提供有利可图机会的环境中，通过福利资格标准抑制正规就业是否会增加犯罪企业活动？我们将行政社会经济微观数据与麦德林十年间的全部逮捕记录相连接，并利用社会经济评分临界点附近正规部门就业的外生变异，低于该临界点的个人若未正规就业则可获得慷慨福利。断点回归估计证实，该政策减少了正规部门就业，并相应增加了与有组织犯罪相关的逮捕。我们没有发现与有组织实体不太可能相关的犯罪（如冲动或机会性犯罪）有所增加。对逮捕的影响在犯罪组织最为普遍的社区最为强烈。

articles.title_en: Ride-Sharing and the Geography of Consumption Industries
articles.title_cn: 网约车与消费产业的地理分布
articles.abstract_en: Cities are centres of the consumption industries—establishments offering nightlife, food, recreation and retail. However, the city’s associated consumer value is inseparable from its geography because residents must travel to consume. By exploiting both the staggered entry across cities and the precise geographic boundary of Uber services for credible identification, we show that the introduction of ride-share technology into a city caused large and significant growth in the consumption industries. We provide evidence that the results are driven by an increase in consumer mobility, due to Uber causing a reduction in the economic cost of travel.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市是消费产业的中心——这些产业包括提供夜生活、餐饮、娱乐和零售的场所。然而，城市相关的消费价值与其地理分布密不可分，因为居民必须出行才能消费。通过利用各城市引入网约车的交错时间以及Uber服务的精确地理边界进行可信识别，我们表明网约车技术进入城市导致了消费产业的大幅显著增长。我们提供的证据表明，这一结果是由消费者流动性增加所驱动的，因为Uber降低了出行的经济成本。

articles.title_en: When Information Conflicts with Obligations: the Role of Motivated Cognition
articles.title_cn: 当信息与义务冲突时：动机性认知的作用
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally test how psychological motivations can impact the processing of purely objective information. We first document that, when the high-stakes College Entrance Exam is held in the month of Ramadan, Chinese Muslim students perform significantly worse. When asked about the impact of fasting, they severely underestimate the cost of taking the exam during Ramadan, even when presented with direct empirical evidence. In the experiment, we randomly offer students reading materials in which well-respected Muslim clerics explain that it is permissible to postpone the fast until after the exam. Consistent with an interpretation of motivated cognition, students who receive the material distort the statistics about the fasting cost significantly less and become more accepting of delaying the fast for the exam.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验检验心理动机如何影响对纯粹客观信息的处理。我们首先记录到，当高考这一高利害考试在斋月举行时，中国穆斯林学生的表现显著更差。当被问及禁食的影响时，他们严重低估了在斋月期间参加考试的成本，即使面对直接的实证证据也是如此。在实验中，我们随机向学生提供阅读材料，其中德高望重的穆斯林学者解释称，将禁食推迟到考试之后是允许的。与动机性认知的解释一致，收到材料的学生对禁食成本的统计数据的扭曲程度显著降低，并且更倾向于接受为考试推迟禁食。
